asset_heavy.reason: Owns a large fleet of tractors and trailers, plus terminals and shop maintenance facilities, needing constant equipment replacement.

big_ticket.reason: Truckload freight shipments are small, frequent, routine purchases for shippers.

cyclical_demand.reason: Truckload freight volumes tied to manufacturing, retail and consumer goods fall in downturns; shippers cut loads and shift carriers.

large_customers.reason: Serves top shippers such as FedEx, Unilever, Whirlpool, Walmart, Lowes, Nestle and Kellogg.

notes: Truckload carrier; some demand is food and consumer staples, so cyclicality is moderate.

offers_products.reason: Sells only truckload transportation; no goods or software are offered.

offers_services.reason: Provides truckload freight transportation: over-the-road, regional and dedicated hauling for shippers.

people_delivered.reason: Asset-based trucking fleet; customers pay for hauling capacity with trucks and trailers, not mainly staff time.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat freight hauling for the same major shippers, including dedicated and regional lanes.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are shippers such as manufacturers, food companies and retailers, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells truckload transport to businesses such as FedEx, Unilever, Whirlpool, Walmart and Quaker Oats.
